objectives_fil: Pakinggan nang walang panghuhusga, ibahagi ang nasuring impormasyong angkop sa edad, at ituro ang confidential service.
Ipaliwanag na mahalaga ang malayang pahintulot, pakinggan ang hangganan niya, at ituro ang serbisyo para sa mas ligtas na pagpili.
Ilarawan ang malalawak na uri ng pamamaraan gamit ang kasalukuyang gabay at ayusin ang counseling sa provider ayon sa pasiya niya.
Iugnay si Dina sa kasalukuyang prenatal service, alamin ang anumang concern na kailangang madaliin, at ayusin ang follow-up.
Gamitin ang aprubadong birth/referral plan, ihanda ang handover sa kwalipikadong team, at ipaliwanag ang sariling saklaw.
Tingnan ang kasalukuyang postnatal schedule at danger guidance, ayusin ang pagbisita, at i-refer ang concern.
Ibahagi ang nasuring essential-care message, magpa-teach-back, at iugnay sa provider kung may concern.
objectives_en: Given a confidential question, provide a respectful, age-appropriate reviewed message and service link.
Given a partner scenario, explain consent and a reviewed safer-sex option.
Given a resident's priorities, describe broad method categories and arrange provider counseling using current materials.
Given a pregnancy case, identify a reviewed prenatal service, danger concern, and follow-up route.
Given a labor/newborn case, describe the BHW's support and the qualified birth/newborn-care team pathway.
Given a postpartum case, identify approved follow-up services and concerning signs.
Given a newborn concern, reinforce approved essential care and link to assessment when needed.
summary_fil: Isagawa ang ligtas na pakikipagtalik: 7 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: Priority area 6: Practice Safe Sex: 7 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
